title: The End-of-Day Reversal After 2019: A Pre-Registered Test on S&P 500 Stocks Excluding Heavily Traded Names
abstract: arXiv:2611.09286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Baltussen, Da and Soebhag (2025) document an end-of-day reversal in U.S. stocks through December 2019: intraday losers outperform intraday winners over the last half hour of trading. We test it on later data, on point-in-time S&P 500 members excluding about 80 heavily traded stocks we had examined in earlier, unpublished work. Under a private pre-registration, the 2016-2019 data had to reproduce the published sign before any statistic linking the sort to the outcome was computed on later primary-sample data. Measured to the last trade before the closing auction, the dollar-volume-weighted reversal is 3.13 bps per day (t = 7.5) in 2016-2019 and 3.05 bps (t = 3.0) in 2023-2026, with a one-sided 95% bound on the decline of 61%. The result depends on the window: the reversal is indistinguishable from zero in 2020-2022, 2023 carries much of the later estimate, and from 2020 onward it is 1.69 bps (t = 2.3), with a bound of 91%. translated_title: 2019年后的日末反转：一项排除高交易量股票的标普500成分股预注册检验
translated_abstract: Baltussen、Da和Soebhag（2025）记录了截至2019年12月美国股票中存在的日末反转现象：在交易的最后半小时内，日内输家跑赢日内赢家。我们在更晚的数据上对其进行检验，样本为时点标普500成分股，并排除了约80只我们在早期未发表研究中考察过的高交易量股票。在私下预注册的约束下，2016-2019年的数据必须先复现已发表结果的方向，之后才能在更晚的主要样本数据上计算任何将分组与结果联系起来的统计量。以收盘竞价前的最后一笔交易为衡量终点，按美元交易量加权的日末反转在2016-2019年为每天3.13个基点（t = 7.5），在2023-2026年为3.05个基点（t = 3.0），衰减幅度的95%单侧置信上限为61%。该结果依赖于时间窗口：2020-2022年间反转与零无法区分，后期估计中很大一部分来自2023年，而自2020年起反转仅为1.69个基点（t = 2.3），衰减上限为91%。一个代理样本，
tldr: 该论文通过私下预注册检验发现，在排除约80只高交易量股票的时点标普500成分股中，日末反转效应在2019年后依然显著存在（2016-2019年为每天3.13个基点，2023-2026年为3.05个基点），但该效应高度依赖于时间窗口，在2020-2022年间与零无异。
en_tdlr: Under a private pre-registration, this paper shows that the end-of-day reversal persists after 2019 on point-in-time S&P 500 members excluding about 80 heavily traded stocks (3.13 bps/day in 2016-2019 vs. 3.05 bps in 2023-2026), though the effect is window-dependent and indistinguishable from zero in 2020-2022.
